decision_horizon: single route intervention followed by native packet-level execution; no sequential policy claim
od_assignment: one OD cell per seed, cyclic over indices 0,1,2; all 12 traffic/event conditions share that cell; partitions balanced across the three cells
stress_definition: GEANT with 20 background OD flows rather than 6: 4 TCP and 16 UDP; original per-flow rates and burst distributions retained; approximately 1.987 times the nominal aggregate offered load, with a UDP-dominated change in composition. No stress outcomes are used for adaptation.
telemetry_observability: Only delivered telemetry.csv records received strictly before decision time. Expected 100 ms sequence schedule begins at 0.4 s. Missing reports are inferred only after a 250 ms timeout. Delay is measured only for delivered reports. No telemetry_delivery.csv or plan.json is read by deployable decision functions.
risk_C_selection: leave-one-development-seed-out logistic loss; refit only on development; validation selects threshold
threshold_selection: Validation candidates satisfying harm rate <=0.05 and <=0.8 of proposer harm, mean utility difference >=-0.01, retention >=0.45 are ranked by harm then utility then retention then threshold. If none qualifies, retain threshold 0.30 and report validation failure; no further tuning.

learning_proposer.implementation: scikit-learn ExtraTreesRegressor; supervised route-utility prediction, explicitly an adapted comparator rather than a reproduction of DOTE or RouteNet-Fermi
learning_proposer.selection: lowest seed-block validation mean squared error over all three action utilities; fit on development only
learning_proposer.risk_training: leave-one-development-seed-out proposer predictions determine candidate-specific harm labels

optimization_proposer: Exact enumeration of three feasible paths minimizing propagation time plus estimated queue drain and declared foreground serialization time; a fluid approximation, not a reproduction of a WAN multicommodity optimizer
independent_unit: whole stochastic seed block; per-topology inference
multiple_comparisons: Holm correction of seed-block sign-flip tests within endpoint and topology; primary revision comparisons are proposer with/without ICTC and adaptation versus unchanged model
zero_event_interpretation: observed zero is not zero population risk; report seed-block bootstrap as conditional uncertainty and a seed-cluster event bound separately

overhead.timing_boundary: disk telemetry parsing, window construction, quality checks, features, proposer and risk inference measured separately and together; no live SDN actuation claim

failures: retain all failures and partial artifacts; resume only validated complete runs; no outcome-based rerun or exclusion
